name: business-obligations-monorepo
description: Monorepo: the business-obligations library (packages/core) and its Next.js playground (apps/web).

scripts.build:web: npm run build -w business-obligations-ui && npm run build -w @business-obligations/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run build -w business-obligations-ui && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.site: npm run build && npm run build:web
